dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But aren't you resting right now?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Resting is a necessary stage in the treasure hunting process. If I'm not well-fed and well-rested, the treasure will find a way to evade me.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: So right now, I am busy resting.
